semantic.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:
semantic.encoding: forward en fp16; pooling CLS; normalización L2; se guarda en float32

fusion.normalization: min-max por consulta; si max == min -> 1.0
fusion.tie_break: ID del documento ascendente (como string), también en el corte del top 10

reranker.batch: todos los candidatos en un lote

hedging.threshold: p95 del reranker medido en calibración

interpretations.replica_model: each stage/replica runs on its own ThreadPoolExecutor (lex 2 workers, sem 1, fusion 2, rerank_a 1, rerank_b 1); both reranker replicas share the same GPU
interpretations.delay_injection: the stage computes its result, then awaits asyncio.sleep(delay) before responding; the worker thread is not blocked by the injected delay
interpretations.error_injection: the stage raises immediately, without computing
interpretations.expired_work: work whose stage deadline already passed when it reaches a worker is skipped
interpretations.hedge_trigger: replica B is sent when A has no valid answer at the threshold (pending or failed) and hedges in the last 60 s < 10% of originals in the last 60 s
interpretations.arrivals: Poisson inter-arrivals from np.random.default_rng(42), identical for every condition with the same rate and for every repetition
interpretations.delay_draws: np.random.default_rng([42, rep, request_index]).random(4) -> lex, sem, rerank_a, rerank_b
interpretations.fusion_failure: if fusion fails or exceeds 50 ms the lexical top 3 is returned (route lex)
interpretations.capacity_throughput: throughput ratio = responses with route=reranked, 3 results and latency <= SLO divided by the requests actually sent in the step (Poisson arrivals make the sent count differ from the nominal rate); all ramp steps run and C is the highest passing rate
interpretations.calibration_hedging: calibration (a) runs with hedging off (threshold unknown); ramp (b) with hedging on
interpretations.hedge_latency: the 1.2 s rerank deadline is shared by both replicas; a hedge sent after the deadline cannot win and its latency equals the stage duration (compute + injected delay), so it may exceed the stage deadline
interpretations.top_k_tie_break: lexical and semantic top 10 also break score ties by ascending document ID

alpha_json.selection_rule: max P@3; then max nDCG@3; then min alpha
alpha_json.encoding: fp16 forward; CLS pooling; L2 float32; stored float32
